title: Tiny, cute hot air balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='balloon' cx='0.4' cy='0.35' r='0.7'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff7a7a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e0304a'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- envelope -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='26' ry='28' fill='url(#balloon)'/>
  <!-- balloon panels -->
  <path d='M50 10 C44 20 42 50 50 66 C58 50 56 20 50 10 Z' fill='#ffd24a'/>
  <path d='M26 40 C30 30 34 24 38 20' stroke='#ffb0b0' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M74 40 C70 30 66 24 62 20' stroke='#ffb0b0' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- balloon mouth -->
  <rect x='43' y='64' width='14' height='5' rx='2' fill='#a82038'/>
  <!-- strings -->
  <line x1='45' y1='69' x2='44' y2='79' stroke='#ffe27a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='55' y1='69' x2='56' y2='79' stroke='#ffe27a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- basket -->
  <rect x='38' y='79' width='24' height='15' rx='3' fill='#c98a4b'/>
  <rect x='38' y='79' width='24' height='4' rx='2' fill='#e0a868'/>
  <line x1='44' y1='83' x2='44' y2='94' stroke='#8f5a28' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='83' x2='50' y2='94' stroke='#8f5a28' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='83' x2='56' y2='94' stroke='#8f5a28' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- little face on basket -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='88' r='1.6' fill='#5a3410'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='88' r='1.6' fill='#5a3410'/>
  <path d='M47 91 Q50 93 53 91' stroke='#5a3410' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
